Fleet & Logistics Officer Job  at ReelFruit




        
    

        
        ReelFruit, founded in 2012, is the market leader in the healthy snack category, pioneering the introduction of healthy dried fruit as a snack in the Nigerian market. The company was founded on a mission to build a scalable agribusiness to add value to the local fruit value chain, produced, package and distribute locally made snacks that could sit on any shelf in the world!

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Fleet & Logistics Officer 

Job Location: Yaba, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Description
     

            
    




	The Fleet & Logistics Officer will assist in managing the day-to-day logistics operations to ensure efficient and timely delivery of goods. This role involves coordinating with various departments, handling documentation, and supporting the logistics team to maintain high operational standards.


Duties & Responsibilities
Fleet Management:


	Assign and schedule vehicles for daily operations.
	Maintain records of vehicle usage and maintenance schedules.
	Oversee driver coordination and compliance checks.
	Record fleet performance data.


Logistics Operations – Nationwide Distribution:


	Track deliveries and update logistics movement reports.
	Coordinate product dispatch and delivery schedules.
	Support communication with third-party logistics providers.
	Maintain delivery records and reporting documentation.


Travel Management:


	Assist in booking flights, accommodation, and transport.
	Maintain travel records and expense documentation.
	Support compliance with travel policies.


Raw Materials Operations:


	Track movement of raw materials from suppliers to the factory.
	Assist in verifying deliveries and documentation.
	Maintain transit and inventory records.
	Support coordination with transporters and warehouses.


Educational Qualifications, Experience & Requirements


	Bachelor's degree / HND in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
	1-3 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, or a related field.
	Strong organizational and time management skills.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
	Knowledge of logistics software and ERP systems (e.g., Odoo) is a plus.
	Ability to work well under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Operational Excellence Specialist - MCL",
  "description": "Maersk is an integrated container logistics company working to connect and simplify its customer&#39;s supply chains. As the global leader in shipping services, the company operates in 130 countries and employs roughly 70,000 people. With simple end-to-end offering of products and digital services, seamless customer engagement and a superior end-to-end delivery network, Maersk enables its customers to trade and grow by transporting goods anywhere - all over the world.&nbsp;

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Operational Excellence Specialist - MCL

Job Location: Agbara, Ogun

Key Responsibilities
Process Improvement &amp; Lean Deployment:


	Identify performance gaps across inbound, storage, order picking, and outbound processes.
	Lead and execute improvement initiatives (Kaizen events, 5S, VSM, SMED, root cause analysis).
	Apply Lean and Six Sigma methodologies (DMAIC, waste elimination, standard work).
	Support process simplification and drive cost, time, and quality improvements.


Standardization &amp; Process Design:


	Develop, document, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Standard Work Instructions.
	Design or review warehouse layouts and material flows using AutoCAD or similar tools.
	Ensure operational standards are aligned with Maersk global frameworks and best practices.


Data Analytics &amp; Performance Management:


	Analyze operational data to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
	Build and maintain performance dashboards (e.g., using Power BI, Excel, or similar tools).
	Measure project impact (productivity, cost reduction, lead time, service level, ROI).
	Support the development of a data-driven performance culture across sites.

 Job Position: Operational Excellence Specialist - MCL

Data Analytics & Performance Management:


	Analyze operational data to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
	Build and maintain performance dashboards (e.g., using Power BI, Excel, or similar tools).
	Measure project impact (productivity, cost reduction, lead time, service level, ROI).

	Embed HSSE and Quality requirements in all improvement activities.

	Plan and execute multiple improvement projects simultaneously.
	Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, HSSE, IT, and Finance to ensure cross-functional alignment.
	Support regional initiatives and share best practices across countries in the West Africa area (e.g., Nigeria, Ghana, Cameroon, Senegal).


Deliverables / Expected Outputs


	Warehouse Value Stream Maps (as-is / to-be) with action plans.
	Documented standardized work and SOPs for key processes.
	Productivity dashboard and KPI performance review.
	5S implementation plans with maturity scorecards.
	Minimum 2–3 Kaizen events per quarter successfully completed with measurable gains.
	Quantified improvements (time, cost, space, or quality savings).

Someone with:


	Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Industrial Engineering, Process Engineering, or related field.

	Proficiency in AutoCAD for layout and flow design.
	Strong analytical and Excel skills; knowledge of Power BI or similar tools.

Job Location: Yaba, Lagos

Description


	To provide strategic leadership and oversight of export/import logistics, fleet management, nationwide distribution, raw materials operations, and travel management, ensuring operational efficiency, cost optimization, compliance, and seamless supply chain execution across all locations.


Duties &amp; Responsibilities
Export &amp; Import Logistics Operations:


	Provide strategic direction for all export operations, including order processing, customs clearance, documentation, and shipment tracking.

	Approve logistics budgets and risk management strategies.
	Evaluate the financial impact of logistics initiatives and process improvements.

	Approve travel policies and ensure alignment with corporate guidelines.

	Ensure compliance with travel procedures and budget controls.

	5&ndash;7 years of progressive experience in logistics, fleet management, export operations, and supply chain management.

	Proven experience managing export documentation and international shipping operations.
	Strong understanding of Nigerian and international trade regulations.
	Experience in fleet management, route optimization, and transportation planning.
	Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
	Excellent analytical, reporting, and problem-solving abilities.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and ERP systems (e.g., Odoo).
	Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
	Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
